trigger_condition: Use only if the direct phylo.maker S3 crosswalk times out or fails before returning a complete candidate-system result.

package_status_logic: prune if normalized species is present in tree$tip.label
bind if species is absent but normalized genus occurs in nodes[level='G'] OR normalized family occurs in nodes[level='F']
equivalence_basis.scenario_invariance: The species.list status vector is determined before S1/S2/S3 tree construction; S3 changes placement geometry for bound tips, not prune/bind/fail status.
equivalence_basis.count_equivalence: The frozen crosswalk admission uses only primary_resolvable_species = prune+bind and prune-only species >=20; therefore vectorized status counts are exactly sufficient for the admission gate.

normalization: Apply the same V.PhyloMaker2 normalization: species spaces -> underscores; uppercase first alphabetic character of species/genus/family; no fuzzy matching.
